title: Meadow Overlook
description: Climb from meadow through a wooded rise to cliffs and a broad overlook, then descend into a new valley.

signs.text:
The low meadow
Follow the trail towards the wooded rise

The wooded rise
Rise through the shaded tree terraces

The cliff terraces
Reverse around the cliff and climb to its top

The meadow overlook
The whole valley lies beneath the broad terrace

Into the new valley
Follow the far side into a different landscape
